text: Apple unveils a standalone Siri app
full-pick-text: Apple unveils a standalone Siri app
notes:
• It will be available in the App Store
  • It includes an integrated storefront for downloading chatbot-style AI apps
  • In this store there will be "AI Extensions" for non chatbot-style apps. These will let developers give access to their data to Siri to use for Personal Context. This will be Apple essentially offering MCP support in to the Siri system.
